SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Com.]
Face most dreadfully swollen, eyes project far out of sockets, can see but a faint glimmer of light with left.
Eyes feel very heavy, larger than usual, painful and pressing out of head, as if something was pressing on top of eyeballs, moving then downward and outward.
Right eye very painful, feeling much larger and more protruded than left.
Right eyeball very sore, < on moving eye.
Eyeballs feel < on moving them.
Catarrhal ophthalmia.
Ciliary neuralgia from asthenopia and chronic iritis.
Eyes more painful near warm stove, with profuse lachrymation.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Com.]
Left ear all cracked and desquamating a substance like powdered starch.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Com.]
Painful burning on face, particularly about eyes.
Left side of face swollen ; left ear all cracked and desquamating a substance like powdered starch.
Very great swelling of face.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Com.]
Second molar tooth right side carious ; pain commences in it at 4.30 to 5 P. M. ; at times shoots down in line with larynx, leaving sore track ; pain < in bed, > from external warmth and pressure.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Com.]
Sloughing ulcer on right breast.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Com.]
Inflammation of left leg and foot, with violent fever ; the swelling increased enormously when the pain subsided ; the skin became white and covered with thin scales, cracked and discharged a sanious fluid.
Indolent ulcer of six years' standing, on lower third of right leg, near external malleolus, of irregular shape and hard edges ; the ulcer was deep and discharged a sanious, fetid pus.
   

FEVER. [40] [Com.]
Violent fever. θ Inflammation of left leg and foot.
   

SKIN. [46] [Com.]
Tormenting itching and burning over whole body.
Red color all over body, resembling scarlet fever.
Skin white and covered with shiny scales ; cracked and discharged sanious fluid. θ Inflammation leg and foot.
Inflammation of the part, with deep, hard-edged ulcers, which discharge a thick, purulent, greenish-yellow matter, having a very peculiar, fetid smell, parts becoming in appearance similar to a piece of raw, decayed meat, while surrounding skin is covered with small shining scales.
Malignant erysipelas ; herpes ; zona ; leprosy.
